facts.text: Grimny's ghost believes his brother Bral, the greediest of the seven dwarves, killed him. Did Bral kill Grimny, and what became of the other dwarves?

Grimny says the dwarves kept a hoard of the mine's best metal. He says Bral probably hid it in the Dragon's Lair, the very small one-room cave marked on the party's map that the dwarves once scouted and found empty.
Is the magical ring Dunk took from the dead dwarf and put on cursed? It let him see and speak with Grimny's ghost, and Dr. Uriah could not tell.
